featured_reviews.name: Sudip Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: The experience was average. Screen quality is not good with too much dust and thread visible on the screen. Chairs are congested, making it difficult to move towards seats. Back seats also get disturbed whenever someone opens the door as sudden brightness affects the viewing. Parking area is available but not sufficient.

featured_reviews.name: Alok Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie Time is just a 10-minute walk from the Dahisar Metro Station, but finding it was a bit of a struggle since there were no signs outside to guide us. Unlike most theatres, there’s no clear entry point, which made things confusing.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. Inside, there’s just one screen, and honestly, the theatre felt more like a small pod. The viewing experience was okay, but the sound quality could have been way better.

Now, let’s talk about the seats—definitely not the most comfortable. Sitting through a long movie was a bit of a task. On the plus side, the food area was clean, but the prices? Almost as high as PVR, which felt a bit much for the overall experience.

One good thing—they have free underground parking for both bikes and cars, which is a rare win in Mumbai!

Overall, if you’re nearby and just want to catch a movie, it works. But if you’re looking for a top-tier cinema experience, this might not be the best pick.

featured_reviews.name: Dhaval Gami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the management. Every time I visit this theatre, I face the same issue regarding my bike helmet. Visitors arriving on two-wheelers are not allowed to carry helmets inside, yet there is no proper and secure facility provided to keep them. Customers are forced to leave their helmets outside at their own risk.

This is an inconvenience and a basic customer service issue that has remained unresolved despite repeated visits. If the theatre does not allow helmets inside, it should provide a safe and organized storage facility for riders.

I request the management to address this issue seriously and implement a proper solution instead of making customers face the same problem every time.

featured_reviews.name: Parmar Ankita
featured_reviews.review_text: What an amazing experience! The chairs smelled like they’ve been there since the theatre opened, the security made me feel like I was entering a top-secret government building, and the lack of AC really gave me that authentic “sauna with mosquitoes” vibe. Truly a night to remember — can’t wait to never come back!

featured_reviews.name: Shyam ji Pal
featured_reviews.review_text:
**Abstractions:**
Movie Time offers a modern and hip atmosphere. The decor is stylish, and the seating is decent and comfortable, making it a great value for money if not a great place to relax before the movie starts.

**Screen Quality:**
The screens are large and well placed, providing a clear picture. The sound quality is impressive, which enhances the overall movie experience. The sound quality is also great.

**Concessions:**
A good selection of snacks and drinks is available. The popcorn is fresh and buttery, you can grab a biscuit here, there is nothing else to eat.

**Staff:**
The staff is friendly and efficient, ensuring a smooth ticketing and concession process.

**Overall Experience:**
Movie Time offers a pleasant movie watching experience with its great facilities and atmosphere. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to have a good night at the movies.

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Powermax
featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Thakur Mall in Dahisar is a popular entertainment hub for residents in the Dahisar and Mira Road areas. Located on the 3rd floor of the mall, it is known for being a well-maintained multiplex that offers a premium cinematic experience at relatively competitive prices compared to other major malls in Mumbai.
Screens: The multiplex typically operates 4 screens, featuring both 2D and 3D projection technology.
​Seating: Options range from standard comfortable seating to luxury recliners (Gold Class) for a more relaxed experience.
​Audio/Visual: Equipped with high-quality sound systems, including Dolby Atmos in select halls, and large screens with high-definition picture quality.
​Accessibility: The cinema is equipped with wheelchair facilities and elevator access.
Refreshments: There is a dedicated F&B counter inside INOX serving classic movie snacks like popcorn, nachos, and sandwiches.
​Food Court: Thakur Mall itself has a multi-cuisine food court on the lower floors, offering a wider variety of dining options after the movie.
​Gaming Zone: There is a gaming area located within the mall, making it a good spot for families and children.
If you're visiting on a weekend, it's advisable to book tickets in advance via apps like BookMyShow, as it is a major landmark and can get quite crowded for blockbuster releases.
Safety system is very nice handle nicely .

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: INOX Thakur Mall - Mira Road really impressed me! 🤩 The atmosphere was absolutely fantastic, and I had such a wonderful time. The staff was super friendly and made my visit extra special. 😊 I particularly loved the comfortable seating and the crystal-clear screen. 🎬 The snack bar had some delicious options too! 🍿😋 I'm definitely planning another trip soon; it's a great spot for a fun outing! 👍 it's just they don't have an Imax screen which is a must at every Inox Cinema 🎥📽️

featured_reviews.name: Keval Somaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re someone who enjoys ads more than movies, this theatre is absolutely perfect for you.

Showtime? More like “suggested time.” I’ve been here multiple times, and without fail, every single show starts 20–30 minutes late. Honestly, you could walk in 20 minutes after the scheduled time and still comfortably sit through a full ad marathon before the movie even begins.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

It’s hard to tell whether the staff is just taking it easy or the management has created some magical, impossible turnaround schedule between shows. Either way, the result is the same: frustration.

A 2-hour movie somehow turns into a 3-hour commitment. Impressive… just not in the way you’d want.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

The in house food is insanely high and seems just looting people e.g selling a regular coke at 350 INR and combo Regular Pop bucket + Coke @ 730 INR. Is INOX selling pop corn and coke over moon or they want to match meal price with Airports. Security Do not allow even soft drinks from outside.
Screens and Seating are good.
Surely Not coming back at INOX Thakur mall anytime for any show.

featured_reviews.name: 91 - Arsh Mansuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst theatre experiences I’ve had.

First of all, the show management was completely messed up. Instead of taking the interval at the proper time (when it was actually shown on screen), they randomly stopped the movie mid-scene after that and suddenly announced an interval 10 minutes later. It totally ruined the flow and mood of the film.

On top of that, the seats were extremely dusty and poorly maintained. Sitting there itself felt uncomfortable and unhygienic.

Overall, very disappointing experience — bad management and zero attention to cleanliness.

featured_reviews.name: nigam sarvaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located conveniently near the National Park in Veena CHSL, Shantivan, Borivali East, Sona Gold Digital Cinema offers a cozy and budget-friendly movie-watching experience for local residents and casual visitors alike.

The theatre may not be as flashy as the big multiplexes, but it holds its charm with a nostalgic feel and a simple setup. The seats are decent and comfortable enough for a casual movie outing, and the sound and picture quality are surprisingly good for the price. It’s a great option for spontaneous plans or watching the latest releases without burning a hole in your pocket.

What stands out is the affordable ticket pricing and convenient location – perfect for locals looking to catch a film without heading to a crowded mall. Staff are polite and helpful, and entry and exit are generally smooth. While the snacks and facilities are basic, they do the job, and cleanliness is maintained reasonably well.

Pros:
- Affordable ticket prices
- Convenient location near National Park
- Decent audio-visual quality
- Friendly staff

Cons:
- Limited screen and seat capacity
- Basic amenities and snack options
- Less suitable for those looking for a premium experience

Overall, Sona Gold Digital Cinema is a reliable neighbourhood theatre that delivers on value. Great for everyday moviegoers and those who appreciate a more laid-back, no-frills cinema outing.

Rating: 3.8/5

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsha Mhadeshwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity Kurla and it turned out to be a fantastic movie experience. It is definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to enjoy a film with friends or family.
The first thing that stands out is the excellent sound quality and screen clarity. The audio system is powerful and immersive, making every scene feel more engaging, especially during action or emotional moments. The picture quality is also very sharp and vibrant, which enhances the overall viewing experience. The theatre is well-maintained, and the seating is comfortable, allowing you to enjoy long movies without any discomfort.
The ambience of the cinema is also very impressive. From the moment you enter, the place feels premium and lively. It is located inside Phoenix Marketcity, so you also get a great mall environment with shopping and entertainment options before or after your movie.
Another major highlight is the variety of food and snacks available. You can choose from popcorn, nachos, burgers, beverages, and more. However, like most multiplexes, the food prices are on the higher side. While the quality is good, you should be prepared to spend a bit extra if you plan to eat there.
In terms of accessibility, the location is very convenient. You can easily reach the cinema by taking an auto rickshaw from Kurla or Vidyavihar railway station, making it a hassle-free destination for moviegoers.
Overall, PVR Cinemas at Phoenix Marketcity Kurla offers a premium and enjoyable movie experience with great sound, visuals, ambience, and accessibility—just keep in mind the slightly expensive food.

featured_reviews.name: Charlie Dha Champion
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently visited this theater expecting a decent movie-watching experience, but it turned out to be an absolute disaster.
To put it simply, everything about this place is below average, and it is easily one of the worst theaters I have ever been to.
​The biggest letdown was the audio quality. In this era of advanced surround sound and Dolby systems, this theater feels like it is stuck in the past. The sound was flat, muffled, and lacked any depth. Honestly, it felt like listening to a movie on a cheap Bluetooth speaker rather than a professional cinema hall system. The bass was nonexistent, and the dialogue was barely clear.the screen quality was poor. A theater is supposed to provide an immersive experience, but this place failed on every front. I highly recommend avoiding this theater until they completely upgrade their sound system and facilities. It is a total waste of time and money.

This is not just a review—this is a formal complaint regarding the extremely poor conditions inside the theatre.

I am currently inside the auditorium, and the air conditioning and ventilation systems appear to be completely non-functional. The environment is unacceptably hot and suffocating, making it impossible to sit comfortably, let alone enjoy the movie. This is a serious lapse in basic customer service standards and raises concerns around health, safety, and hygiene.

Customers are paying premium prices with the expectation of a comfortable and well-maintained environment. What is being delivered here is far below acceptable standards and reflects a complete disregard for customer well-being.

If this issue is not addressed immediately, I will be compelled to escalate this matter further through formal consumer grievance channels and relevant authorities. I expect prompt action and accountability from the management.

Highly disappointing and unacceptable experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited PVR Ghatkopar East to watch the movie Raje Shivaji. During the movie, the screen suddenly went off in the middle of the show. Unfortunately, no staff member took the initiative to inform or assist the audience regarding the issue.
After informing the Duty Manager, Mr. Suryavanshi, he stated that there was a technical issue in the backend due to which the movie got stuck. However, instead of apologizing for the inconvenience caused, his behavior was rude and unprofessional. He simply mentioned that the movie would restart in the next 15 minutes.
When we expressed our disappointment and asked why the movie experience was being disturbed, he responded by saying that it was a technical issue and that he could not do anything about it.
As customers, we expect at least basic courtesy, proper communication, and respectful behavior during such situations. Overall, we felt that there was no concern shown towards customers’ time, money, or emotions.
I kindly request you to look into this matter seriously and ensure that polite, responsible, and customer-friendly managers are assigned to handle such situations in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Jaimeen Bulsara
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Ajanta Cinex. This was our second time coming here. Tucked away in a by-lane, very close to the station (if you’re coming by train) as well as ample parking (if you prefer to come by car/bike) it is super convenient to reach. The movie watching experience itself is amazing, it is currently the only single screen theatre with Dolby sound system. Clean, comfortable seating, delicious food options (we tried the momos, pizza, and coffee, along with the usual samosa and popcorn). The freshly made momos and pizza were better than some of the food places we’ve eaten at. Overall a total 5 on 5 experience. Would definitely come again soon.

featured_reviews.name: Jeevan Nagarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff seemed untrained. The theatre was renovated, but cleaning needs attention there was a slight smell inside, not too strong but enough to distract while watching the movie. They should also put clear directions outside the mall since there are two entrances. At one entrance, the watchman was chewing gutka and just threw hand signs when I asked where the theatre was, which didn’t feel professional. Another odd thing was at the last 10 minutes of the movie, the lights were turned on while it was still playing. On the positive side, the ticket prices were low, the seats were good, and the washrooms were clean, so overall 3 stars for that

featured_reviews.name: Salil Divakaran
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ajanta Cinex is a next to Astoria. The Entrance is on the left side of Astoria store and parking is also in the same lane.

Theatre has 1 screen on the 4th floor. While Coming down we had to take stairs which might not be comfortable for old people or someone with injury to legs. Some alternative should be made and clearly displayed. One star less for that.

Otherwise the theatre is good. Seating is comfortable. Food options are ok similar or slightly lower priced than bigger theatres.

featured_reviews.name: Alquain Murzello
featured_reviews.review_text: Watched Dhurandhar here. Really good sound, superb bass effect, good projection with a well maintained big enough screen, good comfy reclining seats with enough leg room, apt AC temperature controls, good viewing angles especially in the front few rows uptil the middle....and apt affordable pricing of tickets....all these pluses for a single screen theatre is really commendable. Even the staff are helpful... Definitely coming here again.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

featured_reviews.name: Dj Anu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Waghmare
featured_reviews.review_text: Overall Experience is Good, Seats are comfortable but some reclining seats not working properly.  Parking is available for Bike & Car (2 wheeler or 4 wheeler) in basement for bike 20 rs parking charges. Security guards not checking properly, anyone can carry outside food inside theater.

featured_reviews.name: Anish Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.
Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.name: Khushbu Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great movie experience at Maxus Cinemas, Borivali! The screens are bright, the sound quality is excellent, and the seats are super comfortable. The staff is polite and the theatre is always well-maintained. It’s one of the best cinemas in Borivali for a fun and relaxed movie outing with family or friends. Definitely recommend this place for its clean ambience and value-for-money experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krish Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Cinema Borivali completely ruined our experience.
I booked 2 Gold Couple seats, and one recliner was broken. The staff made us wait 25 minutes without any urgency or responsibility.

The canteen guy was extremely rude and was refusing to refund the snacks we purchased. Only after arguing did they process the refund, shocking behaviour from a cinema staff member.

Supervisor Arjun Rathod handled the issue very poorly and provided no real solution.
(Attached image: the staff member present at the time, wearing a white shirt and teal trousers.)

Manager Sukhmil was the only helpful person, but even he had to step in because the rest of the team was completely incompetent.

Pathetic service, untrained staff, and totally unprofessional behaviour. Never coming back.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Gavade
featured_reviews.review_text: The mall is not well maintained. The theater is not that great. We watched Avatar in 3D the screen colours were way too dull and too dark. Couldn't enjoy such a great film.

Inside the theatre is good, the seats are neat and good, sound systems are adequate.
